finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If src_len is manipulated or not correctly calculated, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The size of src_len is not correctly validated or adjusted before use in malloc.

finding.title: Command Injection
finding.trigger: If src contains unexpected or malicious input, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The input src is not validated or sanitized before processing.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.trigger: If src_len is very large, the calculation (src_len / 4 * 3 + 1) could overflow.
finding.assumptions: The size of src_len is not checked for overflow before use in calculations.

finding.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
finding.trigger: If base64_digits array is used for decoding, it could expose sensitive information.
finding.assumptions: The base64_digits array is used in a context where it could expose sensitive data.
